The '''Utozz Prime system''' was located in the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with [[Utozz Prime Brewery]], a corporation that manufactured [[Utozz]], a brand of the beverage known as [[Utoz/Legends|Utoz]].<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Utozz Prime [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA" />
